info.title: PayResolve AI Merchant & Exception REST API
info.description: Production REST API for PayResolve AI — PayPal payment exception detection, real-time evidence graph derivation, AI-assisted root-cause investigations, and human-in-the-loop action approval.

tags.name: Evidence
tags.description: Read-time Evidence Graph derivation and chronological timeline reconstruction linking PayPal events, shop orders, captures, and shipments.

tags.name: Operations Agent
tags.description: AG Studio interactive AI telemetry assistant chat for operational insights, latency queries, and discrepancy alerts.

tags.name: Case Attachments
tags.description: Multimodal file upload and document evidence extraction (PNG, JPEG, PDF) linking receipts and bank proof to cases.

tags.name: Event Inbox
tags.description: Immutable PayPal webhook event logging, HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, and synchronous deduplicated event replay.

tags.name: Benchmark
tags.description: Formal confusion matrix evaluation runner measuring detector precision, recall, and grounding latency against canonical scenarios.

tags.name: Demo Faults
tags.description: Database-backed demo switches injecting transient payment discrepancies (dropped webhooks, altered totals, failed handlers).

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Tamper-evident, append-only operator action history and compliance event trail.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Session-based authentication, BCrypt verification, role authorization (OPERATOR, VIEWER), and CSRF token distribution.

tags.name: Actions
tags.description: Human-in-the-loop action proposals, operator approvals, and automated sync side-effects.

tags.name: Cases
tags.description: Payment exception lifecycle management, pure detector triggers, filtering, and canonical seeding.

tags.name: Investigator
tags.description: Spring AI tool-calling agent with 8 read-only tools, structured report synthesis, and deterministic citation verifier.

tags.name: Demo Shop
tags.description: Mock merchant storefront with cart creation, client order management, and server-side PayPal Sandbox capture.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: High-throughput PayPal webhook ingress with immediate HTTP 200 acknowledgments and background worker queueing.
